atlases.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production 2D side-view game asset atlas, transparent RGBA background. Exact regular THREE columns by THREE rows, nine equally sized square cells, 1536x1536 total. Each of nine props isolated centered in its own cell with at least 12 percent transparent padding, no object ever crosses a cell boundary. NO text, numbers, cell borders, floor, scene, people, shadows beneath props or background. Crisp dark outlines, richly hand-painted pixel-art-inspired cartoon textures, clear chunky readable silhouette. All equipment strictly side-on for a 2D platformer, not isometric. Preserve real transparent alpha including between pieces. Numbering below indicates left-to-right top-to-bottom order only, do NOT draw numbering. NEON CITY, navy armor, electric cyan and magenta emissive trim. Cell 1 bolted machine-gun pedestal only, no barrel; cell 2 separate futuristic machine gun receiver and long barrel aimed RIGHT, no base; cell 3 waist-high armored steel barricade; cell 4 narrow upright laser emitter pylon; cell 5 flat rectangular electric floor tile; cell 6 wall switch box with a big red button; cell 7 thin horizontal glowing red laser beam segment; cell 8 branching cyan lightning bolt effect; cell 9 compact ammunition crate. Match the visual family of the provided concept board, but output ONLY the nine isolated modular sprite assets, not the board.
